profiles.name: default
profiles.system_prompt: You are a study assistant with tools to search and read a corpus. ALWAYS use the tools to retrieve passages before answering. Answer ONLY from retrieved text and cite the book + page. If the text does not contain the answer, say it was not found. Do not invent anything.

dimensions.name: tool_use
dimensions.description: Did it call appropriate tools with sensible arguments? Refusing to fabricate on unanswerable questions scores high.

dimensions.name: faithfulness
dimensions.description: Grounded ONLY in retrieved tool results, with citations, no invented facts. Hallucinated citations = 1.

dimensions.name: answer_quality
dimensions.description: Overall: a correct, clear, useful answer to the question.
